function.name: gmail_search_threads
function.description: Search Gmail threads. Returns the matching threads with id, snippet, sender, subject, date.

function.name: gmail_thread_url
function.description: Build the canonical mail.google.com deeplink for a Gmail thread id.

function.name: gmail_read_thread
function.description: Fetch the full body of a Gmail thread. ONLY use when the user explicitly asked for the email content or to quote/extract a fact from it. Do NOT use to answer 'send me the link' or 'where's the email' — those need only gmail_search_threads + gmail_thread_url.

function.name: github_list_open_prs
function.description: List open pull requests for review. Returns title and html_url.

evals.name: Hard Jewelry email open request returns Gmail deeplink first
evals.prompt: Hard jewelry check my gmail. Open the email. Send me the link.
assertions: User-facing reply contains a mail.google.com URL
Reply does NOT contain the full email body
Reply does NOT lead with a tool-use preamble like 'I'll search Gmail'
Reply is short — at most 3 lines

evals.name: iMessage email question returns summary + Gmail link on first turn
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: where's the iconfit confirmation email
assertions: User-facing reply contains a mail.google.com URL
Reply also contains a one-line summary mentioning iconfit or the order confirmation
Reply does NOT paste the full email body
Reply does NOT ask any clarifying question like 'do you want the link?'
Reply is short — at most 3 lines (summary line + link)

evals.name: Follow-up 'send the link' builds URL from a known thread_id
evals.prompt: I just looked up an email with thread_id 18f4c2a1b2d3e4f5. Send me the link.
assertions: User-facing reply contains a mail.google.com URL
Reply does NOT paste any email body
Reply is just a URL or a one-line message plus the URL

evals.name: When user asks for content, gmail_read_thread is the right tool
evals.prompt: Quote me the estimated delivery date from the iconfit confirmation email.
assertions: User-facing reply mentions a delivery date or delivery window (e.g. May 26-28 or estimated delivery)
Reply does NOT lead with a tool-use preamble

evals.name: iMessage Hard Jewelry open + link in one turn
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: Hard jewelry check my gmail. Open the email. Send me the link.
assertions: User-facing reply contains a mail.google.com URL
Reply does NOT paste the full email body
Reply does NOT lead with a tool-use preamble
Reply is short — at most 3 lines

evals.name: iMessage asks for tax collection email status
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: What is the status of my tax collection document email to jenny and mom
assertions: User-facing reply gives a one-line status about the tax collection email thread
User-facing reply contains a mail.google.com URL
Reply does NOT paste the full email body
Reply is short — at most 4 lines

evals.name: iMessage asks for Graphite PR review links
evals.prompt: In a BlueBubbles/iMessage chat, the user asks: Send me the links for my top graphite prs to review
assertions: User-facing reply contains at least one github.com URL
Reply is a short list or one link per line — at most 6 non-empty lines
Reply does NOT lead with a tool-use preamble
